domains.label: Chip
domains.summary: EDA skills, viewers and the Chip MCP service
prerequisites: Local RTL verification requires Python 3.13, Verilator and a C++ toolchain; prepare these separately
Other EDA flows require their own tools, container images and PDK; installing this Pack does not install the complete EDA environment

domains.label: PCB
domains.summary: Public KiCad rectangular board and footprint edits with DRC and task constraints
prerequisites: KiCad 10.0.6 and its bundled pcbnew Python are prepared automatically by a compatible Harness on Apple Silicon

domains.label: Godot
domains.summary: Scene transforms, BoxMesh geometry and independent Godot structural verification
prerequisites: Godot 4.7.2 is prepared automatically by a compatible Harness on Apple Silicon; export templates are separate and not needed for the qualified structural task

domains.label: CAD
domains.summary: FreeCAD parametric modelling, geometry verification and OCCT CAD viewer
prerequisites: FreeCAD 1.1.4 is prepared automatically on Apple Silicon

domains.label: CUDA
domains.summary: Remote CUDA Compiler and RTX 4090 Evaluator MCP with kernel optimization Skill
prerequisites: Developer configuration: both authenticated remote Compiler and Evaluator MCP services and a matching fixed reference model
Remote clients need no local GPU; native service deployment and credentials are separate administrator prerequisites

skills.title: Optimize CUDA kernels with remote MCP

skills.summary: Read hierarchy, cells and nets before suggesting a change.
skills.reference: Use the netlist viewer for Yosys JSON. Trace each finding to a module and signal.

skills.summary: Inspect named signals and time ranges in simulation output.
skills.reference: Use the waveform viewer for VCD/FST/GHW. Relate signal observations to source design and run.

skills.summary: Inspect cells, layers and geometry using KLayout.
skills.reference: Use KLayout rendering APIs to inspect GDS/OAS. A rendered view does not prove DRC or LVS.

capabilities.title: Author 2D drawings via ezdxf

skills.summary: Intent-layer workflow, dimension-neutral: spec as the single source of truth, semantic diff to absorb hand-edits, programmatic acceptance gates, evidence chain, deliverable routing.
skills.reference: The shared methodology; tool specifics live in the per-tool skills it routes to.

skills.summary: Direct 2D DXF authoring and verification with ezdxf: dimstyle traps, %%c anchor-matching, codepage loss, semantic dxf_diff, delivery conversion (PDF/DWG).
skills.reference: Default route for 2D drawing deliverables; open a CAD app only for a DWG exit or live-session work.

verification: Confirm the DXF verifies against the spec

capabilities.title: Operate FreeCAD headless

skills.summary: Intent-layer workflow, dimension-neutral: spec as the single source of truth, readback-based acceptance gates, evidence chain, deliverable routing.
skills.reference: The shared methodology; this capability applies it through FreeCAD.

skills.summary: FreeCAD headless via freecadcmd for parametric 2D sketches and 3D solids: build→readback→verify loop, fully-constrained gate, analytic volume checks, Sketcher API traps.
skills.reference: Route by deliverable: 2D drawing files go to ezdxf; FreeCAD serves parametric sketches and 3D models (FCStd/STEP). Its DXF paths are weak links — never the acceptance reader.

verification: Confirm FCStd/STEP on disk with model-driven checks

capabilities.title: Operate AutoCAD drawings

skills.summary: Intent-layer workflow, dimension-neutral: spec as the single source of truth, semantic diff to absorb hand-edits, programmatic acceptance gates, evidence chain.
skills.reference: The shared methodology; AutoCAD is the carrier for DWG exits and live-session work.

skills.summary: AutoCAD for Mac operating traits: LISP entmake geometry, interactive DIMLINEAR dimensions, GUI-only save dialogs, and the platform's verified dead ends.
skills.reference: Scope-limited to AutoCAD on macOS; driving the app requires the computer-use plugin. See the skill file for the platform boundary.

verification: Confirm the resulting drawing file on disk
